scope: AI research into official objectives, selected technical references and learning resources. Individual exam delivery, private course contents and live product testing were outside this review.

exam.observation: CISA-specific ISACA outline uses five domains. Both monitored objective text and status matched accepted records.
exam.confidence: High for cited public evidence; booking and live assessment delivery were not tested.

technical.observation: NIST differentiates system contingency planning, emergency response, and organizational resilience when prioritizing recovery.
technical.recommendation: Keep the guide’s recovery planning distinctions; assess downtime and dependencies per system.
technical.confidence: High for the facts stated in the opened source. No live product testing.

learning.observation: ISACA offers a public CISA practice quiz for an initial audit-knowledge gap check.
learning.confidence: High for the public description; private content and exercise outcomes untested.
learning.recommendation: Use its result to pick review topics; no item content reproduced.

exam.observation: ISACA sets governance 18%, risk 20%, program 33%, incident management 29% effective November 3, 2026. Architecture is newly explicit in governance strategy and program development. Format remains 150 questions. Monitor detected an objective-text difference.
exam.confidence: High for cited public evidence; booking and live assessment delivery were not tested.
exam.recommendation: Accept after remapping architecture, external services and revised supporting tasks; archive prior 17/20/33/30 edition.

technical.observation: NIST SP 800-61 Rev. 3 brings incident response into organizational cybersecurity risk management.
technical.recommendation: Retain current revision and integrated governance model.

learning.confidence: High for the public description; private content and exercise outcomes untested.

technical.observation: AWS KMS treats encryption context as authenticated, nonsecret metadata. It can appear unencrypted in CloudTrail, and decryption requires the same context.
technical.recommendation: Retain the guidance to keep sensitive values out of encryption context.

exam.recommendation: Use the future edition for appointments on or after April 15, 2027. The library catalog now records the notice already present in the status snapshot.
